question: Which complete local tiling-wrapper exits, restoration writes and helper effects within the inspected scope must a replacement preserve?

scope.distinctReset: 0x8268CE90 is a separate reset and setup function, not the BeginTiling count and rectangle writer 0x8269CE90.
scope.qualification: Complete direct store, call and return inventories for the eight main functions and selected helpers. Imported and transitive effects, aliases, backing lifetime and caller-live ABI remain qualified; no complete consume contract is established.

dependencies.use: Defines the issue and completion domains, callback, allocator and deferred-record qualifications.
Defines the boundaries for the kept token, link and parser and for external writes.
Defines direct and alias reader limits, shared pools and payload-only mode readers.
Defines the kept dirty-mask and ring and list observations.
Defines selected reset and display, gamma, request and notification observations.

currentEvidence.method: Serial foreground read-only queries through tools/run-headless.ps1; complete raw-word ranges limited to the eight main bodies, narrow windows of the recompiled copy of each exact function and selected handwritten reader windows. Native operands, branches and calls were compared with comments in the recompiled code; no runtime or general execution oracle was used.
currentEvidence.inputQualification: Supported flat SHA256 5C7A8C3AD9B6A9D39CC9BBF3DA5AB23015A568C65C723D298F846086324C4680; mapped [0x82000000,0x83210000) SHA256 389EB006B1DCDE90C5DE775C92D67C18542B8FD9BD39845574206D4B213E9B13. 470 differing bytes in 60 ranges stayed in [0x827F3F50,0x827F4280), outside cited semantic words. Checkout revision is not generated-byte provenance.

localCpuModelBoundary.method: Serial foreground read-only DumpFunctionNeighborhoodBatch and DumpMemoryWords selected six exact entries and adjacent-entry envelopes. All 1161 queried rows, covering 1029 unique words, matched the supported flat image. Installed Capstone 5.0.7 PPC64 big-endian decoded 791 of 796 selected words. Four trailing zero padding words and the CE90 VMX128 semantic arm remain separately qualified; truncated 8-byte save-thunk project extents are not complete body bounds. Existing generated corroboration keeps its own earlier identity; no new generated file was read.
localCpuModelBoundary.beginOrder: AC0A8 calls C588 at 0x826AC0C0 then B0E0 at 0x826AC0C8. Store BE32 G33B4=U32(oldW(G33BC)+1) at 0x826AC0DC, then G33B0=oldW(G33B8) at 0x826AC0EC; only afterward copy five old descriptor words G3438+4*i toG344C+4*i at 0x826AC0F4..AC104. Initialize descriptors G3438,33C0,3424,33D4,33E8,33FC,3410 in that order through C3E0 at 0x826AC110..AC158. Previous pressure, snapshot and initializer helper effects remain real.
localCpuModelBoundary.descriptorInitializer: At 0x8269C3E0, for L and G, store BE32 L+0x10=G, then zeros at L+4, L+8, L+0xC, L+0, in that order; tailcall C170 at 0x8269C3F8. This is not a five-zero-only reset. C170 allocation, link, cache and failure behavior, actual backing and returned full64 value keep the existing selected helper qualifications.
localCpuModelBoundary.recordSelection: Use B=Z32(W(G3440)), unless unsigned U32(B+252)>W(G3444) selects C170 at 0x826AC174; then its actual full64 return becomes B. No null or failure recheck or backing proof is supplied by this local choice. Store G3440=U32(B+252) at 0x826AC1FC, but return full64 B, not the advanced cursor or G. Non-growth B is a zero-extended load; growth preserves the child result.
localCpuModelBoundary.recordWrites: At 0x826AC180/188/190 write BE32 B+0=0x80000000, B+4=W(G3384), B+8=W(G31CC). Origins W(G32C0)/W(G32C4) are read even for zero rectangles. Reload count for loop decision and each continuation at 0x826AC1E8. For i, store U32(x0-ox),U32(y0-oy),U32(x1-ox),U32(y1-oy) atB+0xC+16*i from the corresponding four G31D0+16*i words. Changing counts are not replaced by a single entry sample.
localCpuModelBoundary.recordExtent: Under a stable nonnegative count n, exactly 12+16*n prefix bytes are initialized. Stable n<=15 is a sufficient local 252-byte-fit premise, not a native validation guard. Count 0 writes no rectangles. Preserve untouched suffix bytes: the accepted AB740 contract copies 248 payload bytes, so zeroing uninitialized suffix or inventing a rectangle count changes observations. Valid nonwrapping record and rectangle extents and physical mappings that stay valid remain premises.
localCpuModelBoundary.framesAndReturns: AC0A8 has a 112-byte local frame: a 4-byte LR save at entrySP-8, 8-byte r30 and r31 saves at -24 and -16, and a 4-byte backchain at entrySP-112; restore sites 0x826AC200..AC214 recover LR from its 32-bit slot. Protect direct frame and save ranges, full64 nonvolatile values and every child footprint; arbitrary high-LR or complete thunk ABI is not shown. AC218 frame is 160 bytes at 0x826AC220; BAE8 receives outer count and address cells at currentSP+0x50 and +0x54, each 4 bytes. Keep the already accepted ordering of the three-take, fresh-failure and restore path versus the success path of list, callback, fence and submit, and the caller result translations.
localCpuModelBoundary.wrapperBoundary: CE90 nonzero incoming r7 selects 0x8269D19C/0x8269D1A0, whose Xbox VMX128 interpretation is not established by this scalar decoder; keep that wrapper and the selected helpers or refuse that arm before mutation under a separately proved model. Zero r7 bypasses to two 8-byte zero stores G3390/G3398. The wrapper helper-dependent full64 returns remain distinct from fabricated constant success. D7D8 and BF40 keep their accepted selected-helper and normalization contracts; selected envelope identity does not settle their callees.
localCpuModelBoundary.qualification: These are direct native-store, frame and return refinements that hold only under their conditions. Stable inputs and count, checked arithmetic, readable and writable disjoint mappings, normal instruction, thunk and child execution, and caller-live architectural parity remain required. Descriptor, root, result, allocation and free generations, the 0x8C target, worker delivery, integer N conservation and live suppression are still separate unresolved links. No complete Begin and End or idle-worker consume is accepted.
localCpuModelBoundary.falsifier: Under every stated local premise, wrong descriptor store order, changed saved publication, a different initialized prefix, zeroed observed suffix, lost full64 record return, out-of-span store or wrong failure, list or callback order falsifies the corresponding model. Count 16 needs 268 initialized bytes and disproves an unrestricted 252-byte fit. Unknown VMX128 or helper or alias behavior leaves that path unestablished rather than establishing success.

currentEvidence.localCompleteness: The eight main native ranges contained 1234 words, 159 direct stores, 95 direct BL sites including ABI thunks and 225 branch targets. Each matched its generated instruction or comment locator. Seventeen selected exact functions contained 256 direct stores grouped into 86 guarded families. Complete local writes do not cover unexpanded callees or indirect entry points.

beginAndEnd.begin: BeginTiling 0x8269CE90 writes count G+0x31CC and copies count rectangles of 16 bytes each to G+0x31D0, with zero count leaving old rectangle bytes. It also writes aligned origins and dimensions, parameters, saved surface and state, flags, dirty and predicate state and token records. AC0A8 and kept host ReadGuestTiling read count and rectangles. Other local fields remain subject to the reader boundary below.
beginAndEnd.end: D320 performs its selected Resolve, surface and record work before AC218. D7D8 and DB20 preserve alternate token, saved-state and dirty and mode effects; DB20 can call DA58. D320 and DA58 translate nonzero AC218 into full64 FFFFFFFF8007000E after 90040; success returns 0. DB20 returns its selected DA58 result or 0.
beginAndEnd.unknownFields: G+0x3338,+0x3374,+0x31B0,+0x31A8,+0x319C,+0x31A0,+0x2AB4/+0x2AB8, selected G+0x2ABD bit 0x80 and final G+0x31B4 clear still require exact surviving-reader and alias contracts. Changed G+0x2880 width bits have a kept rebased ACC60 payload reader, but payload-only copying does not establish their necessity after command replacement.

publicationTail.branches: Failure bit 2ABD&0x20 skips publication. Recording byte 2ABC&0x80 can append the separate 34E0 queue record. Nonrecording tiled G33B0!=0 emits a length and address pair; nontiled calls BCA8 then BD98 with r7=0, using its returned cursor. These effects precede the common tail.
publicationTail.nonrollover: Let r28 be the actual post-submit cursor and a=U(r28+31)&0xFFFFFFE0. If a<=G38 unsigned,0x8269C574 writes G3A50=a and 0x8269C578 writes G30=U(a-4). Entry cursor alone is not an oracle for every branch.
publicationTail.rollover: Otherwise 0x8269C55C writes G30=U(r28-4), then 0x8269C564 calls C270(G,0). Prefailed C270 uses the 4800-byte emergency buffer and returns 0. Fresh success or failure updates the cursor, limits and failure state and, only under a condition, waits on then clears G3A5C. Preserve the exact selected exit or refuse rollover before mutation.
publicationTail.readers: Subsequent C400 reads G30 and G3A50; C588 returns G30; shared allocator, snapshot and restore and wait clients consume the resulting state. Recording decoder and reclaim and allocator, wait and import effects remain unknown.

savedPublication.restore: B118 independently reads all six words at 0x8269B118..0x8269B130, restores the six values at 0x8269B134..0x8269B148, and writes G38=U(saved G34-160 decimal) at 0x8269B14C. It has no calls or stack stores and preserves full incoming r3.
savedPublication.survival: AC0A8 calls B0E0 after C588. AC218 allocation failure calls B118 at 0x826AC29C before clearing the failure bit. The kept host EndTiling failure path also invokes B118. C400, C588, BCA8, B618, A6848, B818 and later B0E0 read restored pool and publication state. All six saved words remain needed while this path survives; there is no saved G38 in this set.

internalBrackets.begin: AC0A8 preserves the update, snapshot, descriptor and context order in localCpuModelBoundary: G33B4/G33B0 updates precede the five-word old-descriptor snapshot and seven C3E0 initializations. Its fixed 252-byte record advance does not validate arbitrary rectangle count or initialize the whole observed payload suffix.
internalBrackets.allocationOrder: AC218 optionally calls BAE8, then always calls B818 with 148/40/48 dwords and alignment 32/32/4 before reloading the failure bit. B818's existing-failure path can return 0 without another allocation. Prior successful side-buffer allocations are not rolled back by a later failure.
internalBrackets.failure: AC218 clears G33B0/G33B4, calls B118, clears byte 2ABD bit 0x20 and returns full r3=1, skipping all B508/BF40/BCA8/BD98 calls on this arm.
internalBrackets.success: Finalize seven lists via B508, emit BF40 callback AC020, finalize BCA8, then the optional, middle and final BD98 with r7=0/1/0. Middle is bypassed only for G541C==0 and byte 2ABD bit 2 set. Return r3=0 independently of intermediate BD98 cursor results.
internalBrackets.flags: Known AC218 callers D320 and DA58 pass only high CPU-mask bits or zero; BF40 normalizes (flags&6)==0 with OR6. They cannot supply the generic low4/no2 callback-suppression case. Actual delivery, count conservation and indirect entry points remain separate obligations.
internalBrackets.coherency: BAE8 returns count 11*(a+b), a=(G2E30!=0x00000000FFFFFFFF), b=(G2ABE>>2)&1. Zero count or allocation failure writes count 0 and leaves its address output untouched. Its atomic old-range exchange has a separate local frame and sentinel effect.

distinctReset.local: 0x8268CE90 has only stack and ABI direct stores. It calls C8E0(G,input+0x48); a nonzero result exits unchanged. On zero it calls C810, A60F8 and A5EB8, in that order. A5EB8 success returns 0; failure calls A60F8 again then returns full64 FFFFFFFF8007000E.
distinctReset.transitive: A60F8 unbinds and drains only under a condition, Releases and clears G39EC/39F0/39E8. A5EB8 writes video dimensions before later creation failures; successful partial surface pointers remain until cleanup. It copies 124 bytes to G34E8, changes G3528 and on success writes G4144=FFFFFFFF after selected gamma and notification effects. C8E0 frees and reconfigures ring, pool, B and S2, and performs registration, issue, completed and worker-lifecycle effects. These are not consequences of a no-store wrapper alone.
distinctReset.qualification: Preserve selected helper outputs and failures, resource lifetime and the kept display and request readers or replace them coherently. The full set of transitive creation, free, import, alias and nested-frame paths is not shown.

nextDiscriminator: Identify the kept bit and field readers for the explicit unknown local fields; do not convert direct-reader negatives or payload-only copies into omission.

The C3E0 local stores and tailcall are in localCpuModelBoundary. Its selected C170 allocator, target and backing effects, surface, state and Resolve helpers and pointed outputs still require exact-context ownership and execution, within the inspected scope, before transitive exit completeness.
Identify the actual allocator target, generation, free and reuse, recording decoder and reclaim, and rollover wait outcomes; preserve or refuse those paths.
Prove nested stack, output and physical disjointness, caller-live registers and ordered host observations before omitting spills, packets or helpers.
guards: No selected nonstack write is proved omittable here. Needed holds only while the named consumer is kept, not permanent guest backing after complete reader replacement.
A local no-store wrapper, successful sampled exit or complete local instruction inventory does not establish transitive absence or consume acceptance.
Do not confuse 0x8268CE90 reset with 0x8269CE90 BeginTiling, saved G34 with G38, or dwords with bytes.
conclusion: Complete local wrapper, saved-publication and selected helper exits are enumerated. Six saved words, cursor and limit tails, failure ordering, records and kept state have concrete observations; transitive helpers, aliases, allocator, lifetime and ABI still constrain replacement.
